messages:
maya: I'm starting the handoff for tonight. I'm primary until 21:00 UTC. Quick checklist before I go: PD access, AWS cross-account role, Grafana editor access for dashboards, and the runbook pointer.

maya: Current primary -> maya, secondary -> tom. If anything hits >2 min latency on inference-prod, page primary first then secondary if no ack in 2 min.

tom: ack. I also have the emergency AWS creds in my 1Password vault (redwood/oncall/emergency) and my assume-role script is ~/bin/assume-redwood-prod.sh if you need to loop me in.

maya: thanks. Leaving notes: last deploy at 18:12 UTC (eng-releases/deploy-batch-42), no errors. We saw a 5% increase in 429s around 18:40 that self-resolved after autoscaler bump.

incident-bot: [incident-bot] New incident created: INC-2026-03-15-101 (High 429 spike on /v1/generate). Bridge: /r/bridge/INC-2026-03-15-101.

maya: pinging the thread because while I finish the handoff we still have that open pager. Action items: 1) Confirm PD escalation rules for criticals are intact, 2) make sure grafana alerting contact list includes both primary and secondary, 3) ensure the runbook links are accessible.

leo: quick check: PD escalation rule for inference-prod-critical points to the "eng-oncall" schedule and then up to the eng leads. I just verified in PD — tom is included as secondary override.

sophia: grafana dashboard ACL: inference-prod-dash is shared to team "eng-sre" and to tom@s.redwood.com as editor. maya, do you have viewer or editor?

maya: I have editor. I'm about to handover. Confirming runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/inference/latency-429 (readable).

nate: small coverage gap alert: APAC night shift isn't staffed tonight until 02:00 UTC. If the region dies and traffic shifts, we may see higher latencies. Recommend keeping the autoscaler threshold lowered and enabling burst pool for 30m.

tom: noted. I can toggle burst pool if needed, but I need AWS assume-role access (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Prod-Admin). maya, can you confirm I still have that permission?

maya: yes, tom still has the role. To assume run:

```bash
source ~/secrets/aws-env.sh
./assume-redwood-prod.sh --role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Prod-Admin
aws sts get-caller-identity
```

maya: also adding quick Grafana play: to mute noisy alert rule, go to Alerting -> Rules -> inference-429 -> Mute for -> 30m. Keep an eye on the alert history before muting.

tom: I confirmed I can assume-role locally. ran get-caller-identity, looks good.

sophia: small perms note: if someone can't edit Grafana, the workaround is to open a runbook issue and tag @eng-sre; we have a 5–10 min escalation. But both of you should be fine.

maya: I'm handing off: primary -> tom, secondary -> leo. Leaving last knowns: KV cache warming status: 95% across models, model variant rwd-7b-quant has been serving since 18:20.

maya: Logs for recent 429s: see snippet below (sanitized)

```text
2026-03-15T18:40:23Z inference-prod-04 kubelet: pod cpu spike -> queuing increased -> 429 on /v1/generate -> autoscaler scaled +3 pods
2026-03-15T18:41:02Z inference-prod-02 nginx: upstream prematurely closed connection
```

incident-bot: [incident-bot] Reminder: on-call handoff checklist not completed: confirm PagerDuty emergency contact method.

tom: I got the handoff, thanks maya. I'll be primary until 21:00 UTC. My phone is on. If you want to leave a quick note about the alert thresholds you changed, paste them here.

maya: changed autoscaler threshold from 75% cpu to 65% cpu at 18:45 for 30m. Also disabled an experimental caching rule (cache-prefix: alpha-testing) at 18:50.

leo: I'll monitor Grafana for latency spikes and keep an eye on SLO dashboard. If you need me to take over PD at any point, ping me and I will assume secondary -> primary.

tom: small todo — verify PD contact method (sms vs push). If pager doesn't ping phone, we should call. I have my mobile number in PD profile. Maya, did you set up sms fallback?

maya: yes PD has sms fallback enabled for emergency policy. Also added escalation to oncall leads after 2 minutes.

nate: for audit, make sure to record any credential assumes in the incident doc. We need to paste the STS call id if you assume role.

tom: will do. One more check — Grafana panels I might need write access for: alert silences, annotation writes. I have those.

tom: taking over bridge now: /r/bridge/INC-2026-03-15-101. I'll post a quick summary and link runbook.

tom: summary posted to bridge: "Taking over as primary. Monitoring autoscaler and queuing. If you see sustained 429s, escalate to leo and toggle burst pool."

sophia: FYI ops-runbook has a short troubleshooting checklist under "429 spike" that includes: 1) check queue lengths, 2) check backend model health, 3) scale pods, 4) toggle burst pool, 5) mute noisy alerts.

maya: thanks all. I'm off now. If anything escalates while I'm away, please page and escalate per PD policy. :wave: :slightly_smiling_face:

tom: thanks — ack and taking over. Logging assume-role id: AR123-STSID-7890 (will paste full STS call in incident doc).

leo: good handoff. I'll be on standby.

incident-bot: [incident-bot] Handoff complete. Handoff notes appended to INC-2026-03-15-101.

tom: closing thread here, will update incident doc with actions and STS id.
